title: A multi-scale framework for reliable surface-function correlation: MATLAB code
description: MATLAB code reproducing every simulation result, table and figure of the paper 'A multi-scale framework for reliable surface-function correlation'. The framework applies three gates scale by scale (discrimination, reliability, functional correlation), followed by bootstrap and leave-one-specimen-out robustness checks. run_all.m runs the whole chain; README.md maps each table and figure of the paper to the script that produces it.
